title: $T_{E,\Qlb}$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
For a prime $\ell$, a scheme $X$, a finite extension $E$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\Qlb$ and a
bounded constructible complex $K$ of $E_X$-modules ([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), the
complex $T_{E,\Qlb}K$ ([def-sfb-derived-extend-to-qlbar]) is a bounded constructible complex of
$\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}$-modules.

proof.text:
As for [lem-sfb-extend-subfield-constructible], with [lem-sfb-qlbar-flat] in place of
flatness of $F_X$: $T_{E,\Qlb}$ is computed termwise, so it preserves boundedness and
$H^n(T_{E,\Qlb}K)=\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell,X}\otimes_{E_X}H^n(K)$, and tensoring local finite presentations on
the strata of a finite stratification ([sk-def-sfb-constructible]) gives local finite
presentations.
